title: 第811章 人族当灭还不束手就擒第810章 阴谋离开炎黄山
slug: 全民宗主合成亿万傀儡
content_zh:
凤皇山，凤殿。
凤苍雪得到消息后，猛地起身，震惊道：“你们确定是乾元界界主王海？”
“大长老，这是炎黄山传出来的消息，并且各族探子都看到王海界主独自离开。”
“炎黄山居然敢让他独自离开？疯了！”
别人不清楚王海的特殊，她很清楚。
这种宝贝疙瘩居然让他独自外出冒险？
你人族现在有魔族联盟那个大敌在外，还有无数种族盯着你们的秘密，居然还敢如此？
而且一旦对方出事，对凤族的影响是巨大的，毕竟只有王海拥有提纯凤血的能力。
凤苍雪来回踱步，心中越发焦急，思索片刻后咬牙道：“不行！他不能出事！”
“二长老，速速前来大殿。”
凤苍雪取出的传音玉符亮起又暗淡，片刻后，一道身影快速抵达，皱眉道：“大长老，何事如此惊慌？”
“人族乾元界界主王海从炎黄山离开了，你速速追上去，务必要确保对方不能出事！”
“嗯？什么意思？”
“你亲自去保证他的安全，若是他陷入生命危险，要及时出手相助。若是没有危险，不要干涉他的行动。”
二长老微愣，再次确认消息后，脸色严肃的转身快速离开。
......
龙皇山，龙殿。
龙渊收到消息后，也很是震惊。
最近炎黄山一直处于封锁中，人族成功阻止魔族联盟一百多场进攻，还将魔族的三座高级小世界收入囊中，这一切都使得炎黄山成为众矢之的，万族都想探寻人族的秘密。
经过万族的讨论，人族诡异之处的聚焦点集中在了乾元界。

自从那个小世界有修士飞升后，炎黄山就开始不对劲。
先是一次性飞升一群人，非常反常。
然后，炎黄山为了这个小世界飞升的修士，杀龙族接引使、毁龙族接引殿。
之后又是夸张的万人飞升。
这种特殊，自然让乾元界界主成为众矢之的。
无数种族的探子在拼尽全力的搜寻信息，王海哪怕信息暴露的再少，可他是乾元界界主的信息，还是能够探听到的。
现在，一直隐藏起来的王海，独自离开了炎黄山。
这谁能放过？
龙渊震惊之后，紧皱眉头思索，想到龙族那条幼年金龙还在秦皇手中，只能忍着内心的渴望，没有下令去把王海抓来。
可想到万族绝对会想尽办法的抓捕王海，又有些不甘心。
片刻后，他看向大殿内一人：“三长老，由你亲自去跟随乾元界界主王海，若是他被别的种族掳走，你视情况将他带到龙皇山。”
王海被别的种族抓住，龙族再出手相救，这样将其带到龙皇山手段就比较平和。
有了这样一个特殊之人在，他们在秦皇那里就没有那么被动了。
龙渊想到这，对自己的计策越发满意。
......
魔皇山。
魔戾得知这个消息，满是不敢置信。
他反复确认。
“你确定是乾元界界主王海？”
content_en:
Fenghuang Mountain, Fengdian.
After Feng Cangxue got the news, she stood up suddenly and said in shock: "Are you sure it is Wang Hai, the master of Qianyuan Realm?"
"Great Elder, this is the news from Yanhuang Mountain, and spies from all races saw Wang Hai Realm Master leaving alone."
"Yanhuang Mountain actually dares to let him leave alone? Crazy!"
Others don't know how special Wang Hai is, but she knows it very well.
This kind of baby bump actually allows him to go out on adventures alone?
Your human race now has the great enemy of the Demon Alliance outside, and countless races are watching your secrets. How dare you do this?
And if something happens to the other party, the impact on the Phoenix clan will be huge. After all, only Wang Hai has the ability to purify Phoenix blood.
Feng Cangxue paced back and forth, feeling increasingly anxious. After thinking for a moment, she gritted her teeth and said, "No! Nothing can happen to him!"
"Second Elder, come to the main hall quickly."
The sound-transmitting jade talisman that Feng Cangxue took out lit up and dimmed. A moment later, a figure arrived quickly and frowned: "Great Elder, why are you so panicked?"
"Wang Hai, the leader of the Qianyuan Realm of the human race, has left Yanhuang Mountain. You should catch up quickly and make sure nothing happens to him!"
"Huh? What do you mean?"
"You personally ensure his safety. If his life is in danger, help him in time. If there is no danger, do not interfere with his actions."
The second elder was slightly stunned. After confirming the news again, he turned around and left quickly with a serious face.
...
Dragon Emperor Mountain, Dragon Palace.
Long Yuan was also shocked after receiving the news.
Yanhuang Mountain has been under blockade recently. The human race has successfully prevented more than a hundred attacks from the Demon Clan Alliance, and has also captured three high-level small worlds of the Demon Clan. All of this has made Yanhuang Mountain a target of public criticism, and all races want to explore the secrets of the human race.
After discussions among all races, the focus of the strangeness of the human race was on the Qianyuan Realm.
Ever since a monk ascended to that small world, something was wrong in Yanhuang Mountain.
First, a group of people ascended at once, which was very abnormal.
Then, Yanhuang Mountain killed the dragon clan's reception envoys and destroyed the dragon clan's reception hall for the sake of the ascended monks in this small world.
Then there was an exaggerated ascension of tens of thousands of people.
This kind of specialness naturally makes the master of the Qianyuan Realm a target of public criticism.
Spies from countless races are trying their best to search for information. Even if Wang Hai's information is exposed, the information that he is the master of the Qianyuan Realm can still be detected.
Now, Wang Hai, who had been hiding, left Yanhuang Mountain alone.
Who can let this go?
After Long Yuan was shocked, he frowned and thought. Thinking that the young golden dragon of the Dragon Clan was still in the hands of Emperor Qin, he could only endure his inner desire and did not order to capture Wang Hai.
But thinking that Wanzu would definitely try their best to capture Wang Hai, they felt a little unwilling.
After a moment, he looked at a person in the hall: "Third Elder, you will personally follow Wang Hai, the leader of the Qianyuan Realm. If he is kidnapped by another race, you will take him to Dragon King Mountain according to the situation."
Wang Hai was caught by another race, and the dragon race came to rescue him. This way, the method of bringing him to Dragon King Mountain was relatively peaceful.
With such a special person around, they would not be so passive with Emperor Qin.
Long Yuan thought of this and became more and more satisfied with his strategy.
...
Demon King Mountain.
Mo Ru was in disbelief when he heard the news.
He confirmed it repeatedly.
"Are you sure you are Wang Hai, the lord of the Qianyuan Realm?"
